address: Moselstraße 5, Reil an der Mosel, 56861, Germany
bio: In the fine dining restaurant of Villa Melsheimer, you can look forward to imaginative and creative modern dishes that are made from very good fresh ingredients. In summer, the gorgeous terrace overlooking the Moselle beckons! Should the weather not cooperate, you can also enjoy the view from the bright winter garden. The boutique hotel has comfortable guest rooms for overnight stays....
